verdict.rationale: Penpot documents first-party self-hosting in private cloud, on-premise, or any controlled environment. Supported deployment paths include docker compose, an official Helm Chart, Openshift and Rancher. Community users confirm they have self-hosted it on Docker/Portainer successfully. missing for 10: consistent hands-on stability evidence, since one user reports a self-hosted instance crashing after a few minutes while others report it works fine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Penpot is the only open-source design platform that is truly deployment agnostic. Run it in your private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control.
Deploy with docker compose ... Use Kubernetes in its different flavors: Deploy the official Helm Chart, Deploy in Openshift, Deploy in Rancher
you can set up an instance of Penpot in just 3 minutes!
Have been self-hosting this on Docker/Portainer for several weeks for a few people. Works fine so far.
